correctness.rationale: From D(p^a q^b)=p^{a-1}q^{b-1}(aq+bp) and phi(p^a q^b)=p^{a-1}q^{b-1}(p-1)(q-1), the equation is p(b+1)=(p-a-1)q+1. Positivity of b forces 1<=a<=p-2 for odd fixed smaller p; each a forces exactly one nonzero congruence q=(a+1)^{-1} mod p, uniquely determining positive b for sufficiently large q. Writing c=p-a-1, log(p^a q^b)=(c/p)q log q+O_p(log q), giving q cutoff (p/c) log X/loglog X. PNT in AP for fixed p yields p/[c(p-1)] log X/(loglog X)^2 in that class. Distinct classes sum to p H_(p-2)/(p-1). Independent exact brute factorization for n<=250000 recovered 15,1225,3993,218491; finite regression does not establish the asymptotic.
